sample_translations.source: Kay maaram gud kamo ngahaw nga maabot an Adlaw han Ginoo sugad hin pag-abot hin kawatan ha kagab-ihon.
sample_translations.reference: for you know very well that the day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.
sample_translations.translation: For you yourselves know very well that the day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.

sample_translations.source: Sanglit ginbuhat han mga anak ni Jacob sumala han iginsugo niya ha ira;
sample_translations.reference: So Jacob’s sons did as he had commanded them:
sample_translations.translation: And the sons of Jacob did as he commanded them.

sample_translations.source: Nabido an mga tawo tungod han mga Benjaminhon kay ginbungkag han Ginoo an pagkaurosa han mga tribo han Israel.
sample_translations.reference: The people grieved for Benjamin, because the Lord had made a gap in the tribes of Israel.
sample_translations.translation: The people were distressed because of Benjamin, for Jehovah had disrupted the unity of the tribes of Israel.

sample_translations.source: “Kon katapos hini ngatanan nga mga kastigo, diri la gihapon kamo mamati ha akon, kundi magpadayon kamo hin pag-ato ha akon,
sample_translations.reference: “ ‘If in spite of these things you do not accept my correction but continue to be hostile toward me,
sample_translations.translation: Even if after all these punishments you still refuse to listen to me and continue to oppose me,

sample_translations.source: Nagtikang pagtutdo ha ira hi Jesus: “Pagbantay kamo basi diri kamo mauwat hin tawo.
sample_translations.reference: Jesus said to them: “Watch out that no one deceives you.
sample_translations.translation: Then Jesus began to instruct them, "Watch out that you do not take anyone in your hands.
